data.gender_notes: Nalain is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'nalah', meaning 'rain'. This name signifies the gentle, calming effect of rain during the night, and is a symbol of beauty and tranquility. The name Nalain carries the meaning “Night rain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Nalain usually hope their child will grow to embody night rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the divine blessings of Allah SWT, in the form of rain, that nourish and sustain life.
data.etymology: Nalain belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nalain total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نالين
in_arabic.long_meaning: يُشتق نالين من الحرف الناطقة بالعربية النائل، النال، واليَن، التي تعني "النيل" أو "الوصول". يرتبط هذا التسمية بالهجرة النبوية، حيث عُرف النبي محمد بالنيل، حيث كان يُستخدم كرمز للصبر والصلاة. وقد أُستخدمت هذه التسمية في القرآن الكريم، حيث يُذكَر النيل كرمز للقوة والجود. في الإسلام، يُعد النيل مصدراً للبركة والرزق، حيث يُشير إلى النيل المتفجر من الأرض، الذي يُحيي الحياة ويُجلب الرزق. من المعروف أن النيل يُعتبر رمزاً للنور والخير، حيث يُعتبر مصدراً للبركة والرزق. يُعد النيل أيضاً رمزاً للوحدة والاتصال، حيث يُشير إلى الوحدة بين الله والبشر.

in_english.name: Nalain
in_english.meaning: Nalain is an Arabic name that means "nectar" or "honey", symbolizing the sweetness and purity of the soul.
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nalain is derived from the Arabic root "n-l-n", which means "nectar" or "honey". In Islamic tradition, nectar is a symbol of the sweetness and purity of the soul. It is also associated with the concept of "baraka", or divine blessing, which is a central theme in Islamic spirituality. The name Nalain is also seen as a reflection of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) character, who was known for his kindness, compassion, and generosity. In modern times, the name Nalain has become popular among Muslims, who see it as a symbol of hope, guidance, and spiritual growth.
